$schema_note: Canonical model-versions registry for Lyra's predictive models. Source of truth; the human view is MODEL-REGISTRY.md (generated-alongside, not from). Kept honest by scripts/check-model-registry.mjs (npm run check:model-registry, CI-gated): the north-star reading must tie to a recorded row in model-metrics-history.jsonl by corpus hash, the deployed champion must match the frozen artifact, and every code_versions string must exist in the worker. A number here that no artifact/history/code backs is a build failure, by design.

north_star.one_line: Out-of-sample lift over base rate among the top 5% highest-probability names, on the ONE-SHOT holdout, random slice.
north_star.plain_english: Of our very top picks, how many more actually became winners than you'd get from a random pick - measured on data the model never trained on, on the honest random sample (not the curated hindsight names). A lift of 1.0x is no edge (random); 2.0x means our top picks are twice as winner-dense as chance.
north_star.why_this_one: It is base-rate-normalised (comparable across corpora as winner density drifts), it is the headline the report card already commits to, it has bootstrap confidence intervals, and it is measured on the one-shot holdout so it cannot be tuned up by iterating. Crucially it is aligned with the product truth: surfacing is only earned when the top of the queue is reliably winner-dense out of sample.
north_star.role_of_this_registry: This registry is the MACHINE-CHECKED VERSION LEDGER + honesty gate, not a competing north-star declaration. The destination + full target-state stack (L0-L5, earn-gates, arrived definition) lives in lyra-modelling/NORTH-STAR.md; the current letter grades live in lyra-evals/MODEL-REPORT-CARD.md. This file tracks every version against the one number and BINDS that number to the frozen artifact + recorded history + code (check:model-registry), so no doc can quote a metric that no artifact backs.

current.note: Gen-3 corpus (nine of ten domains lit; insider flow + federal awards added). The gen-2 1.94x -> gen-3 1.69x move is NOISE, not decline: the first cross-generation paired test put the delta at -0.18 CI90[-0.57,+0.20]. A boosted challenger scored 2.13x this cycle but was NOT promoted (paired tie vs the incumbent). Still an optimistic bound on a survivor-biased corpus. Fuller gen-3 timeline reconciliation with lyra-evals/generations/GENERATION-LOG.md is owed.

arrived_definition.measured_on: random-slice, DELISTED-INCLUSIVE holdout at a real ~3% base rate (>= ~9% top-pick precision with the ruin class present)
arrived_definition.worst_cohort: beats its null in >= 90% of quarters (no dead regimes)
arrived_definition.live_calibration: sustains the surfacing gate for two consecutive quarters (live evidence, not backtest)
arrived_definition.per_name_receipt: probability + conformal interval, top SHAP factors, two named historical analogues with outcomes, gate verdicts, timing annotation

interim_milestone.note: A waypoint, not the destination. Current 1.72x is an OPTIMISTIC BOUND on a survivor-biased corpus; the 3.0x arrived bar is defined on the delisted-inclusive corpus precisely so the number is real, not flattering.

target.unlocks: Nothing on its own. Surfacing promotion remains a separate, founder-gated decision fed by live calibration (monitor.model_health), never by backtest numbers alone.

guardrails.one_line: No market regime worse than random: worst quarterly-cohort lift@k must be >= 1.0.
guardrails.note: Gen-3 cleared this: the worst quarter now beats random (1.33x, was 0.83x in gen-2). Surfacing is still gated - the arrived bar wants >=90% of quarters beating null AND ECE <= 0.03 at deployment prevalence AND live-calibration evidence, none confirmed yet.

guardrails.one_line: Probabilities mean what they say: adaptive (equal-mass) ECE must be <= 0.05.
guardrails.note: Regressed in gen-3 (0.042 -> 0.084): the champion's calibration proved feature-generation-sensitive as domains lit up. A slope-corrected artifact seam is shipped but inert; it earns its way through the standing loop.

guardrails.one_line: Anti-gaming: any lift > 2.0x from this feature set triggers a mandatory leakage decomposition before it is recorded anywhere.
guardrails.note: A suspiciously strong number is treated as a leak until proven otherwise. Standing rule from MODEL-REPORT-CARD.md improvement rules.

north_star.improvement_rule: A new model version counts as an IMPROVEMENT only if (a) the north star rises, (b) NO guardrail regresses, (c) it is measured on a FRESH one-shot holdout, and (d) it separates from the incumbent by confidence-interval (not point estimate). Anything short of all four is 'a change', not 'an improvement' - and the registry records it as such.

deployed_champion.force_reason: Force-promoted over the bootstrap-synthetic incumbent whose floor-comparison lift (2.774) was a SYNTHETIC self-evaluation, not a real-world number - the incumbent was refuted on the real holdout at 0.70x. Promoting the real-data model that clears 1.72x on real holdout over a synthetic artifact that fails at 0.70x on real holdout is correct; the floor's 'regression vs 2.774' was comparing against a fiction. Recorded here so the forced=true flag reads as a deliberate, reasoned act, not a silent override.
deployed_champion.surfacing: gated (shadow-live / Beta) - logs to the immutable ledger, never surfaces as a decision until the worst_cohort_lift guardrail clears and live calibration earns it

versions.algorithm: logistic-regression (stdlib GD, L2) over 10 domain scores + completeness
versions.dataset: historical-survivor-v1 (real point-in-time, curated hindsight names excluded from training)
versions.leakage_decomposition: 2.77x first run -> 1.47x (-theme leak) -> 1.35x (-curated names) -> 1.31x (-purge bug) -> 1.72x holdout confirm. Adversarial review removed each real leak before the number was reported.
versions.verdict: First model to learn REAL, out-of-time signal: holdout top-5% picks were 23.1% doublers vs 13.4% random. Genuine but modest research-queue edge; nowhere near tradeable; worst regime still below random.

versions.algorithm: logistic-regression over 10 domain scores + completeness, trained on reproducible bootstrap synthetic data
versions.verdict: Learned the hand-designed hypothesis faithfully - the hypothesis was wrong. Its honest role was proving the training lifecycle end to end, which it did. Retained in git history.

versions.algorithm: transparent hand-designed calibrated logistic over the 10 domain scores (DOMAIN_WEIGHTS + bias)
versions.status: REFUTED AS RANKER - retained as interpretable feature layer + coverage report, never as ranking authority
versions.verdict: Its top picks contain FEWER winners than random (0.68x). The hand-designed weights bet on technical + comfortable liquidity, both of which anti-predict real 12-month doublers. Kept for its legibility (10 named domains) - which is exactly what let the backtest refute it cleanly.

feature_and_engine_log.change: Real SEC EDGAR fundamentals (share-count dilution + gross-margin trend, CIK-authoritative); multi-market universe (US + ASX + FX + Stooq fallback); p_2x_12m outcome; coverage-honesty render fixes (unavailable domains render as gaps, null market caps hollow).
feature_and_engine_log.note: These are honest feature-coverage + plumbing changes, not an isolated retrain, so they carry no independent north-star delta. They EXPAND the substrate the next champion can learn from (more real domains lit up, more markets), which is where the next north-star move must come from - per MODEL-REPORT-CARD.md Stage 2.

feature_and_engine_log.change: Removed the silent 0.5 default for unsupplied news_attention / portfolio_relevance - the ranker now renormalises over signals actually known instead of fabricating 25% of the priority weight on every real candidate.
feature_and_engine_log.note: A correctness/honesty fix to the ranking math, not a learned-model change. Recorded because it changes surfaced ordering on real candidates.

classifier_trained.note: Lifecycle default label; the deployed champion artifact overrides it to 'emerging-winner-classifier-real-v1' at train time (see deployed_champion.model_version).

sophistication_ladder.note: Where each layer sits, honestly. Full grading in MODEL-REPORT-CARD.md.
levels: L0 screens / hand-picked lists (most retail tools)
L1 hand-weighted composite scores <- reference scorecard (REFUTED as ranker)
L2 linear model, real labels, honest CV <- real-v1 champion is HERE (with L4-grade eval discipline)
L3 nonlinear tabular (GBDT), interactions, per-regime validation
L4 point-in-time multi-source features (filings, insider, contracts), delisted-inclusive corpus
L5 sequence/graph models, regime conditioning, ensembles with uncertainty
sophistication_ladder.current: eval discipline L4, estimator L2, data L1.5 - and that gap IS the roadmap
